# Nearly full is not nearly fine

`customer_support.heu.queue_management.nearly_full_is_not_nearly_fine` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A team at almost-full utilisation is not a short step away from comfortable.


## The heuristic

**A team at almost-full utilisation is not a short step away from comfortable.**


_Why:_ The relationship between utilisation and wait is not a straight line — it bends upward sharply as arrivals approach the service rate. The last sliver of spare capacity is what absorbs variance in arrivals and handling time; remove it and the queue stops recovering between spikes and begins compounding them.
